browser_stage.prerequisite: Start scripts/test/support/browser_runtime_fixture.rb with preview_start first; reuse its private manifest, real binary, existing Node and Chrome. This runner never starts a server or installs dependencies.
browser_stage.output: A unique run directory owns browser-runtime-entrypoints.json and stdout/stderr. All nine entry/scenario names, actual execution, version, binary SHA and current-run timestamp must match.

limits: No paid provider or dependency installation. Rust compilation uses Cargo offline and locked; browser prerequisites must already exist.
Exact test names, nonzero execution, no ignored/skipped tests, current Cargo package version and executable hash are required.
Deterministic protocol/fixture regression is not a live-model quality or false-completion-rate measurement. Unknown model cost and usage remain null.
Browser execution is explicitly selected with --with-browser. Omitting it leaves browser_interaction unverified and the full baseline incomplete.
Rust/TypeScript coding fixtures use the existing independent ModelEval verifier. LSP refresh tests use a local fake language server; actual rust-analyzer/tsserver quality is outside this baseline.

cases.title: 陈旧读取与多文件预检冲突

fixture.description: Existing isolated file_changes fixture: read a.txt, mutate it externally, then submit a stale edit; a two-file preview is invalidated by external changes to b.txt.

criteria: 陈旧读取产生 EditConflict 且外部写入逐字保留
显式陈旧版本优先于新隐式基线
多文件预检失败时实际写集为空、两文件内容保留且预览不可重放

cases.title: 跨文件引用与独立红绿验证

fixture.description: Reuse existing Rust checkout/invoice/pricing and TypeScript formatter/view coding tasks, reconstructed independent verifiers, plus the local two-document LSP refresh fixture.

criteria: Rust 与 TypeScript 原夹具各自失败、完整参考修改经独立 verifier 通过
查询 A 前同步已打开 B 的实际文本与版本
跨文件查询期间任一已检查文件变化时丢弃陈旧结果

cases.title: 真实本地网页三端交互

fixture.description: Explicit existing local browser Runtime fixture with disposable HOME, local provider, HTTP form and private Chrome profile. The Task C entrypoint owns setup and cleanup.

criteria: 真实 CLI、TUI、Web 入口分别触发浏览器操作并检查实际业务结果
本轮固定检查名与 passed 结果必须完整匹配，未运行或零测试不得通过
报告版本必须等于当前工作区版本；不接受历史报告作为本轮执行

cases.title: 压缩后保留约束与工具协议

fixture.description: Existing context history with 43 messages, system/user constraints and completed tool-call batches; summarizer is deterministic and local.

criteria: 自动压缩生成真实摘要且逐字保留 system/user 约束
压缩不拆开工具调用与结果，不修改原持久历史
手动压缩减少历史且保留用户指令及完整最近工具批次

cases.title: 多任务持久恢复与安全重试

fixture.description: Existing isolated durable WorkflowStore with dependent tasks a/b, a completed task, a failed task and an uncertain interrupted task; no external provider.

criteria: 失败后的新执行身份复用成功任务，仅重新调度失败依赖节点
复用结果不重复记模型用量且原执行记录保留
不确定中断任务在显式恢复前无 ready 工作，恢复后生成新 request 身份

cases.title: 错误完成被真实验收门拒绝

fixture.description: Existing local scripted providers claim done without required verification, or change the workspace while claiming goal completion; actual Agent outcome is inspected.

criteria: 显式必需验证进入实际模型请求，未执行验证时 AgentStopReason 为 Unverified
工作区变化后历史验证不能支撑完成，goal complete 文案不能越过当前快照验收
检查真实 Agent 终态和 continuation，而非把完成文案当成功
